simple.meaning: לִמּוּד (limmûwd) is a Hebrew word meaning “instructed.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לִמּוּד (H3928) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 8:16, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לִמּוּד (H3928) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לִמּוּד (H3928) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לִמּוּד (limmûwd) / H3928 is traced through Isaiah 8:16, Isaiah 50:4, Isaiah 54:13, Jeremiah 2:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3928. limmud לִמֻּד adjective taught ; — ׳ל Jer 2:24 ; plural לִמּוּדִים Isa 50:4 (twice in verse); construct לִמּוּדֵי 54:13 ; לִמֻּדֵי Jer 13:23 ; suffix לִמֻּדַי Isa 8:16 ; — 1 taught , as disciples Isa 8:16 ; 50:4 (twice in verse); 54:13 . 2 accustomed to something, מִדְבָּר לִמֻּד Jer 2:24 (wild ass) accustomed to the wilderness ; הָרֵעַ לִמֻּדֵי 13:23 accustomed to do evil.
